name: 4Ls
description: The team looks back on a piece of work through four questions: what it liked, learned, lacked and longed for. It suits a thoughtful look at a project.

columns.name: Liked
columns.prompt: What did you enjoy or appreciate?

columns.name: Learned
columns.prompt: What did you learn that you did not know before?

columns.name: Lacked
columns.prompt: What was missing or got in your way?

columns.name: Longed for
columns.prompt: What did you wish for that we did not have?

mood.neutral: Calm and structured, good for a focused team.

goal.reflect-project: Four angles cover the whole project.

checkInQuestion: What is one thing from the project you are proud of?
facilitationTips: Give an example for each of the four columns to get people started.
Tell the team that Lacked is about missing things, Longed for is about wishes.
Group similar notes together before you discuss them.
